description: Historical sensor calibration log for ball-on-arc ToF sensors. Each entry records the LEFT and RIGHT sensor center_mm values at physical equilibrium (ball resting at arc center), plus the resulting SENSOR_OFFSET_RAD. The active values are always in constants.py:SystemConstants.
units: mm for center values, rad for offset

entries.note: Initial factory/mounting calibration. Center values estimated from mechanical drawing. Offset not yet characterised.

First empirical equilibrium calibration. Ball held at physical center, sensors read LEFT=193 RIGHT=160. Residual +4.76 mrad absorbed as SENSOR_OFFSET_RAD=0.007 software correction rather than updating center_mm constants.

Second empirical equilibrium calibration. Ball at physical center reads LEFT=196 RIGHT=144. RIGHT sensor drifted -16 mm since entry 2 (dominant source of offset drift). center_mm constants updated to equilibrium values directly; SENSOR_OFFSET_RAD set to 0.0.
